# qwen3_0_6b_cpu_reference.json

Fuel's own CPU reference for the Qwen3-0.6B yardstick (ROADMAP M0, `tests/qwen3_cpu_yardstick.rs`):
per-prompt greedy decode steps (token id, max |logit|, top-16 logits) for 32 steps of each prompt in
`PROMPTS`, plus the measured spread between two reduction orders (`rerun_spread_max_abs_delta`).

**Produced by Fuel, not copied from anyone.** It is generated by
`cargo run -p fuel-transformers --features dev-tools --example qwen3_yardstick_tool -- regenerate`
(`regenerate_qwen3_cpu_reference_fixture` in `src/dev_tools/qwen3_yardstick.rs`), which runs the
quantized model on Fuel's CPU kernels. The numbers are Fuel's output; the file contains no weights,
no tokenizer data and no third-party text beyond the prompts the harness itself defines.
